items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and continue only bounded evidence work. Woot’s public terms do not evidence rights for public data reuse; legal, security, accuracy, attribution, and measurement gates remain blocked. Fleet actionability is constrained: 157 approved proposals lack execution requests, 26 requests failed, and zero improvements are proven. The smallest next steps are to drain existing approved report work and measure deployed changes; no new launch or spend is justified. For the only unblocked action, queue the reversible CLS repair for trainingsharks.com. rc-9.com is rejected this cycle because an active repair work item already exists.

Handoff: execute the existing approved fleet security evidence commitment through the open work item. Preserve unknowns caused by unavailable fleet-doctor and operations sweeps; do not treat missing evidence as a pass or create duplicate telemetry requests.
